clue.text: Take judicious amount of 14, say

parts.note: to take someone in is to do or swindle them
sage means wise or judicious

explanation.surface: Advice to measure out a sensible quantity of some medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is the answer to 14-across, a miracle medicine, so the definition is a measured quantity of a drug. 'Take' looks like part of the instruction but gives DO, as in to do someone out of money.
explanation.definitionFit: A prescribed portion of a drug such as a wonder drug is its dose, the quantity to be taken.

clue.text: Arbitrary government place is held by Democrat

explanation.walkthrough: Only one 'is' gives letters; the 'is' of 'is held by' belongs to the indicator. 'place' is SPOT, as in a spot on the map.
explanation.definitionFit: Rule by a tyrant with absolute power is government by arbitrary will.

clue.text: Let off after mocking performance, one keeps getting knocked down

explanation.definitionFit: In ninepins or bowling games each pin is repeatedly toppled by the ball.

clue.text: Person who empties drainage trough

explanation.definitionFit: One who removes a fish's insides, and also a channel at a roof edge draining rain.

clue.text: Second present: headgear that may come to a peak

clue.text: Bit of stationery concerning clerical worker

clue.text: Escape monster blowing top in fight

clue.text: Quickly heading away from Northeast by twelve inches

clue.text: Declining unit accepts article without enthusiasm
